Off-peak tips for shift swaps
You can use this page

Shift swaps at the Companion Animal Travel Desk

When the desk is quieter, a smooth handover helps the next shift keep animal travel running calmly. At Aurelia Skyways, we look after passengers and their pets with steady attention, so a clean swap matters even on an easy day.

Start by checking the active cases, open messages, and any special care notes already in progress. If a traveler has a pet booked for a longer route, make sure the care plan is easy to follow and that the handover notes are clear. A calm summary of what has been done, what still needs attention, and what should be watched next is usually enough to keep things moving.

It also helps to share anything that affects comfort or handling. Some animals do best with a quieter area, while others settle better with extra reassurance and a familiar routine. The cabin team relies on these notes during flight, so keep the language simple and direct. If a traveler has already spoken with the desk about a pet's temperament, include that detail in the swap notes.

Before you leave the desk, glance over any messages that are still waiting for a reply. A quick review of the booking status, pet documents, and any updates from the skyport staff can prevent confusion later. If something looks incomplete, leave a clear note for the next coordinator so they know where to pick it up.

When possible, keep the tone of the handover friendly and steady. Travelers notice when the desk feels organized, and that reassurance matters when they are trusting us with a pet's journey. Even a short exchange can make the next shift more confident if the details are tidy and easy to read.

If you are unsure whether a case is ready to move on, pass along the concern and flag it in the desk record. It is better to leave a careful note than to assume someone else will spot the issue. The goal is always to support the pet, the traveler, and the cabin team with the same level of care.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
